name: Hiperco50HS_740C
variant: annealed 740 C / 1 h, yield 86 ksi (593 MPa)

provenance.source: Carpenter Electrification datasheet Hiperco 50 HS (E198, v05-20) p. 4 typical DC table, docs/sources/materials/carpenter_hiperco_50hs_E198.pdf. Grade C: no data below 800 A/m, so the curve below 800 A/m is the B-H pipeline's interpolation from the origin; no unannealed state (cold-rolled 50HS must be annealed, Carpenter: 704-760 C, before it is magnetically usable).
provenance.anneal_recipe: 740 C (1364 F) 1 h, dry hydrogen, cool 100 C/h

stacking_factor_source: PROVISIONAL: the Carpenter datasheet gives no stacking factor; 0.95 is a placeholder until the lamination supplier states one
saturation_polarisation_source: Carpenter E198 p. 1: magnetic saturation 24 kilogauss
